thread:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — some new tenants hit a delayed onboarding flow this morning. Reports of welcome emails and first ingest taking ~30m-2h. Seeing ~120 affected tenants so far.
Marco (CS Lead): Thanks. Any short-term mitigation? Which cohorts impacted?
Aisha (CS): Mostly EU & APAC customers who were opted into the microbatch sync rollout. High-touch customers included a handful of trial accounts and 3 paid SMBs.
Sam (SRE): We have an active alert: microbatch-worker-queue backlog spiked at 03:12 UTC. Investigating whether KV cache eviction + retry storms amplified the backlog.
Priya (Eng): Looking at logs now. There's a pathological case where a rare 502 from our ingest upstream triggers exponential retry with jitter off. Patch in progress to add a circuit-breaker and rate-limit retries.
Aisha (CS): Need a short, clear customer note we can send to affected accounts. Prefers a one-paragraph status first, then offer an office hour + credits if impacted.
Marco (CS Lead): Draft outreach please — concise and empathetic. Include expected ETA for fix, what we're doing now, and next steps.
Priya (Eng): ETA: deploy patch in ~45m to stop retry amplification. After deploy backlog should drain in ~20–40m depending on tenant queue size. Will post deployment + drain confirmation.
OpsBot: Incident opened: INC-202703-1422. Severity: Sev2. Noted affected component: microbatch-sync workers.
Sam (SRE): Mitigation steps we’ve started: 1) paused retry loop for non-critical batches, 2) increased worker concurrency on backlog nodes, 3) routing fallback for VIP customers to synchronous path.
Aisha (CS): Perfect. I'll prepare segmented messaging: (A) high-touch escalations (manual email + phone), (B) affected trials (email + credit offer), (C) broader notice to rollout group.
Marco (CS Lead): Share drafts here. Keep language non-blamey and include link to office hours calendar. Also request any customers we should ping before the message goes out.
Aisha (CS): Draft 1 below — feedback welcome:
```
Hi — we’re reaching out because we detected delays in your initial data sync and onboarding emails this morning. Our engineers traced this to an internal retry amplification in the microbatch sync system which caused processing queues to backlog. We are deploying a fix to stop the retries and routing VIP customers through an alternative path; queues are expected to clear within ~1h after the deploy.
We sincerely apologize for the disruption. If you’d like live help we’re holding office hours at https://cal.example.com/office-hours and can offer a credit for impacted time. Reply here and we’ll prioritize you.
— Redwood Inference Support
```
Priya (Eng): Suggest adding a short bullet about data integrity: "No data loss — all events are queued and will be processed; order preserved for completed batches."
Aisha (CS): Good call. Updated draft includes that.
Jordan (Customer): Quick note — we saw delayed search indexing, not loss. Appreciated the update. Please prioritize processing order — we rely on sequence for our dedupe.
Sam (SRE): Confirmed: ordering preserved. We're not discarding events, just delaying.
Marco (CS Lead): Final checklist before sending: 1) confirm deploy timestamp + rollback plan, 2) tag affected accounts for priority routing, 3) create office-hours thread and link, 4) confirm credit guidelines.
Priya (Eng): Deploy scheduled at 04:10 UTC (in ~30m). Rollback plan is revert retry change and re-enable previous behavior; will only rollback if regressions in path.
Aisha (CS): Credit guideline suggestion: 1 day pro-rated credit for tenants with >30m delay or trials affected. Approve?
Marco (CS Lead): Approve for now. We’ll escalate exceptions to Executive CS.
Aisha (CS): Sending high-touch emails now to 6 VIPs, will send batch email to rest once deploy is confirmed. Copying draft into Zendesk macro.
OpsBot: Deploy event: DEPLOY-2027-03-04-04:10 completed by Priya. Status: success.
Priya (Eng): Patch live. Monitoring queue drain.
Sam (SRE): Queues 60% drained after 15m. Still watching throughput and tail latency.
Aisha (CS): Sending update email now: short note + link to office hours + credit offer.
Marco (CS Lead): Nicely done team. After this stabilizes, please prepare a post-incident note for customers that includes root cause and steps to prevent recurrence.
Priya (Eng): Will prepare RCA. Short summary: rare retry amplification due to upstream 502 combined with missing backoff guard — will add circuit breaker + retry cap + observability on retry loops.
Aisha (CS): Capture customer feedback during office hours — will log into the incident doc.
Jordan (Customer): Thanks for the quick turnaround and follow-up. Office hours was helpful.
Aisha (CS): Closing thread for now. Will reopen if any residuals.
